summary_en: drakefjustin said the zkSync Airbender team proves every L1 EVM block on two RTX 5090s at about 1kW. Offchain Labs argued RISC-V is a poor L1 delivery ISA and WASM is better. OnticNexus proposed state locks as proposer commitments for stronger preconfirmation guarantees.
